title: Now Using Claude Code to Edit My Videos
description:
I hate editing videos. That is the honest reason I started messing around in Claude Code, and it now handles the parts of the edit I used to dread.

🔔 Subscribe for more real AI experiments: https://youtube.com/@SamanthaLearnsItAll
🎥 Full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_RMM_Kn2qDE

Most people hear AI video editing and picture one button and a finished video. That is not what happened. What actually worked was handing off the repetitive work, the cuts, the caption timing, the graphics, and keeping my own judgment on everything a viewer actually feels. That split is what made it usable instead of a gimmick.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
- Why I moved the busywork of video editing into Claude Code
- The part of editing you should never hand to AI

About this video: Now Using Claude Code to Edit My Videos. What AI video editing actually does well, and where it still needs a human making the call.

HUGE CREDIT GIVEN TO:  @nateherk   whose videos got me started on this.

TOOLS MENTIONED
Claude Code: https://claude.com/claude-code
Wispr Flow (voice to text): https://ref.wisprflow.ai/samantha-cook

#Shorts #ClaudeCode #AIVideoEditing #VideoEditing #AITools
